nobox.final_span:
Nissan reported 32,033 miles of self-driving, which may seem impressive until you consider the total of 58 disengagements and a disengagement rate of 659 miles per disengagement.
Licenses granted to tech companies in California have been dominated by Silicon Valley powerhouses and former Google subsidiaries. Since the new rules took effect two years ago, Waymo, including Cruise, Zoox, and ride-hail companies like Lyft, has driven 56 percent of the miles required by California’s regulators. Lyft drove 12 percent, Zoox 8 percent, and Cruise 7 percent.
